title: Comparing equity awards — Priya Nair
instructions: Priya Nair receives options on **1,000 shares** with a **$20** strike price. She exercises when the stock is worth **$50**. Compute the results under each scenario (ignore payroll taxes).

exhibits.title: Scenarios
exhibits.content:
**A.** The options are NQSOs. She sells the shares 2 years after exercise for **$70**.
**B.** The options are ISOs. She sells 2 years after exercise (3 years after grant) for **$70**.
**C.** The options are ISOs. She sells 6 months after exercise for **$45**.

rows.label: A: long-term capital gain on sale
B: AMT adjustment in the exercise year
rows.explanation: The 30,000 spread is an AMT preference item.

rows.label: B: long-term capital gain on sale
C: ordinary income on the disqualifying sale
rows.explanation: Lesser of the spread (30,000) or actual gain (45,000 − 20,000 = 25,000) = **25,000**.

rows.label: C: capital gain on the sale

parts.prompt: When does Priya's employer get a deduction?

rows.label: Scenario A (NQSO)
rows.explanation: The employer deducts when the employee recognizes income.

rows.label: Scenario B (qualifying ISO)
rows.explanation: No deduction for a qualifying ISO disposition.

rows.label: Scenario C (disqualifying ISO)
rows.explanation: The employer deducts the employee's ordinary income.
